title: Quote Tolerance Forms for Work Added After Drop-Off — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the quote tolerance takes exactly one of three forms, set by the operations booked on the ticket after its drop-off date — operation charges whose booking date is later than the drop-off date shown on the ticket.

| Operations booked after the drop-off date | Customer | Form, and the quote tolerance it gives |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | any | per-operation form: a flat tolerance of 5.00 USD for each of them |
| exactly one | active member at Finch Circle Platinum or above (a Finch Circle Loyalty Program tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 2500.00 USD or more) | excess form: the quote tolerance percentage of the overrun charges above the quoted total |
| exactly one | a customer below Finch Circle Platinum | quote form: the quote tolerance percentage of the quoted total |
| none | any | quote form: the quote tolerance percentage of the quoted total |

**Terms.** Overrun charges are every operation charge and every lined surcharge charge booked on the ticket; the part above the quoted total is the overrun charges less the quoted total, or nil when they do not exceed it. Operations booked on the drop-off date itself are not operations booked after it.

## Thresholds, both sides

- One operation booked after drop-off: a percentage row. Two: 5.00 USD each, that is 10.00 USD, whatever the membership.

## Hypothetical cases (quoted total 200.00 USD, overrun charges 260.00 USD, quote tolerance percentage taken as 6 for illustration)

| Operations after drop-off | Member at Platinum or above | Quote tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | either | 15.00 USD |
| 1 | yes | 6 percent of 60.00, that is 3.60 USD |
| 1 | no | 6 percent of 200.00, that is 12.00 USD |
| 0 | yes | 6 percent of 200.00, that is 12.00 USD |
